title: Discord emoji reactions become affect signals and gentle request vectors (never commands)
description:
Evidence: today src/channels/discord/adapter.ts onReactionAdd ingests only two reactions — ❌ deletes the companion's own message, and the operator-configurable trigger reaction (discordTriggerReactions, default 👆) re-fires a full response turn on the reacted message (the existing re-react nudge). Every other emoji is dropped by the matchesTriggerReaction early-return before any ingestion — reactions on companion messages carry no affect signal and no request semantics. This bead adds two new reaction semantics.

Context (operator design, 2026-07-09 voice note): reactions should become soft affect/intent channels, never commands. TWO CLASSES of reaction semantics: (a) AFFECT INFORMATION — generically-used positive/negative emojis (hearts, fire, crying, …) ingested as emotion/appraisal input tied to the reacted message; feeds the VAD/appraisal path (EmotionAppraisal, src/core/emotion/appraisal.ts, which already gates on VAD movement); impacts companion state, creates no reply obligation. (b) REQUEST MAPPINGS — specific emojis enter the turn context as gentle, declinable suggestions via the context-system-note lane (the room-entry-note sink pattern, src/core/session/room-entry-note.ts); NOTHING IS FORCED — the companion retains the ability to not do the thing. Default mappings: 📢 = please send a voice message (activates once the voice pipeline lands); 🔁 = please regenerate/re-answer this; 🤫 (shushing_face) = easter egg, a soft "please quiet down for a little bit" (time-bounded gentle damping of proactive output, never a mute); 🤔 = "can you elaborate / explain more"; 📷 = selfie request (future media tooling). Existing behavior to preserve: 👆 already works as the re-react nudge when she does not react.

Scope: reaction ingestion in the Discord adapter (Events.MessageReactionAdd incl. partials — Partials.Reaction and the partial-fetch path are already wired); classification via the operator-configurable mapping (bead psfn-framework-emj2) with the defaults above; unmapped emojis fall to the generic-affect class or are dropped; requests flow through the normal turn pipeline as low-pressure context/system notes (fatigue/charge apply — reactions are not free turns; tool gating not bypassed); under multi-companion accounts (channels.json discord.accounts, exactly one companionId per bot — parseDiscordAccounts in src/channels/backplane/config.ts; gateway per-account inbound routing in src/boundary/gateway/channel-surfaces.ts), a reaction routes only to the companion whose bot authored the reacted message. Non-goals: forcing behavior, auto-executing tools on reaction, Telegram parity (note as follow-up).

Acceptance: 🤔 on a companion message yields an elaboration suggestion she may act on or decline; ❤️ measurably feeds appraisal input with no reply; 🤫 gently suppresses proactive output for a bounded period unless she chooses otherwise; a reaction on companion A's message never reaches companion B.

title: Emoji→action mapping: owner-config surface + Garden settings UX
description:
Operator-editable mapping from emoji to either a tool/request kind or a short free-text suggestion template (e.g. 🤔 → "can you elaborate, or explain more").

Scope: a config surface following the owner-file/settings-contract pattern (src/system/config/settings-contract-guard.ts + src/system/config/startup-owner-files.ts) — decide in-implementation whether it lives in the channels.json discord section or a dedicated owner file — seeded with emj1's defaults (📢/🔁/🤫/🤔/📷/👆), fail-closed validation (unknown fields, duplicate emoji, empty template all rejected); a Garden admin API to read/update the mapping; and a Garden settings UI page for the mapping. Note the UI portion needs a browser-capable session (same constraint as admin-ui bead psfn-framework-vinz.30).

Dependency: emj1 (psfn-framework-emj1) consumes this mapping. emj1 can ship first with hardcoded defaults and later read from this surface once it lands — so this bead blocks emj1's operator-config path, not emj1's initial delivery.

Acceptance: operator remaps 🤔 to a custom phrase via Garden and the next 🤔 reaction carries that phrase; an invalid mapping is rejected both at save and at startup (fail-closed).
